coverage.note: The 16 missing-group shots lack both pf_passive and wall. Shot 26963 is otherwise complete but omits vertw. Missing evidence is not a configuration.

representation_signatures.meaning: Rounded EFIT setup representations reproduced byte-for-byte from the Ambix signature algorithm. These are provenance, not machine identity.

adjudications.evidence: The vertw family exists with identical surrounding physical geometry on shots 26961 and 26964. All three shots share EFIT setup signature 1cb6f2ee742c4ee4. A single omitted family cannot establish hardware removal and reinstatement across two unobserved shot gaps.

identity_rule: Only canonical conductor, passive, wall, topology, turns or polarity, and diagnostic pose changes split a machine configuration. Solver cells, element counts, weights, mesh resolution, padding, and source omissions do not.
